note: All tunable numbers in one place (GAME EXPANSION; Bob's spec: balance lives in data files).
_overworld_note: Chunks (32 x 32 tiles) of the overworld drawn beyond the camera's chunk; chunks more than one beyond are freed. 2 covers a zoomed-out phone view with room to spare. Agent proposal for B8-011.
_child_food_note: A child gets hungry this much as fast as an adult, so eats this share of an adult's food; every household and village food reckoning weights children the same way (NPCBrain.food_factor). NPCs have no ages yet, so the role decides. Agent proposal, provisional: balance review pending (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md).
_sprint_note: B8-027: sprint multiplies the player's speed by sprint_speed and costs sprint_stamina_per_sec net of regeneration; it ends when stamina runs out and cannot start below sprint_min_stamina. L3 toggles it on a pad; Shift is held on a keyboard unless sprint_toggle is true (then Shift toggles). Agent proposal, provisional.

tree_growth._note: PROVISIONAL (agent proposal, owner approval pending): the tree lifecycle (Trees, tools/living_forest.py art). A felled mature tree is a stump for tree_regrow_days, then a sapling that grows sapling -> young -> growing -> mature; the stage lengths are in game days. Only MATURE trees can be felled: it takes `chops` axe blows, the cut marks showing the damage; a hurt tree heals after heal_minutes. Felling a mature tree gives sapling_count sapling(s) with chance sapling_chance (the player only); the player plants one on free grass in front of them. Development only: the command-line flag --tree-growth N (honoured only in debug builds, see docs/TREES.md) makes trees grow N times faster.

_plants_note: Wild flowers and berry bushes (owner B8-015/B8-016): a picked plant is bare, and ripe again at the dawn this many days later. Agent proposal, provisional: balance review pending (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md).
_caravan_note: The caravan is a finite regional market (B7-014): it holds a purse that starts at caravan_float, gains up to caravan_allowance coins a day (the region's demand for the village's surplus; less as the village's coins approach caravan_ceiling_per_head a head, and nothing at the ceiling; never above caravan_float) and every coin the village pays it for ore, coal and stone, and spends at most caravan_coins a visit and never more than it holds. The village's currency can only grow by the allowance and never past the ceiling. Agent proposal, provisional - balance review pending.
_property_note: Property and land (owner rules 2026-10-18: the manor sells and lets land and houses, rent weekly; the numbers are agent proposals, provisional: balance review pending, docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md 'Property and land'). plot_price is a 9x10 plot's price, other ground by area; house_price a house with its ground; a week's rent is weekly_rent_share of the price; the manor buys back at sell_back_share; rent_evict_missed unpaid weeks end a lease; a vacant stall is let rent-free to a villager out of work with stall_min_coins to stock it.
_construction_note: Property phase 2 (owner rules 2026-10-18: free placement anywhere legal, ground bought or leased on the spot; materials only; helpers hired for coin carry the owner's goods; crowded households split; workshops are buildings with stations, built after a house). Every number here is an agent proposal, provisional: balance review pending (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md 'Property and construction, phase 2'). workshop_cost: materials per workshop kind; workshop_price: a workshop with its ground, as house_price is a house's; helper_wage: a day's carrying, paid by the employer when hired (the manor's day wage); split_*: a household whose living members outnumber its house's beds founds a new household when, after paying for the new home, it keeps split_keep_base + split_keep_per_member coins a member staying behind; founder_build_days: the helper days a founder budgets for.

animals._note: Owner rules: animals get hungry and die unfed like the villagers; keepers and the player feed livestock, wild animals graze; a well-fed male and female breed; babies are half scale until grown; animals become meat. The numbers are agent proposals (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md). start = [males, females] per pen or per wood; keep = breeding adults that hunters and keepers leave; feed = wheat per meal.

_government_note: Manor treasury, taxes, wages, granary and relief (owner-approved B3 plan, docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md). Days are measured in the treasury's daily obligations (wages).
_manor_job_note: A manor job's wage is set aside while the treasury keeps this many days of obligations after it (B7-009): the line the evening's repairs already use (3 days of wages). treasury_reserve_days (10) stays for tax rates and for hiring staff. Agent proposal, provisional - balance review pending.
_household_note: Household economics and job mobility (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md): agent proposals using existing jobs and wages.
_theft_note: Theft, shops and containers (owner rules 2026-10-18; the numbers are agent proposals, docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md). A guard who sees a theft, hears a caught pickpocket's victim within guard_call_radius, or questions a seller of stolen goods returns the goods and fines theft_fine coins to the treasury.
